---
# Icinga GitOps: OCP Prod node readiness
apiVersion: monitoring.rhdp.redhat.com/v1
kind: CheckDefinition
metadata:
  name: ocp-prod-nodes-ready
spec:
  expectedNodes: 25
  warnBelowReady: 24
  critBelowReady: 20
  checkIntervalSeconds: 300

answer:
ocp-prod-nodes-ready is in a WARNING state, reporting 22 of 25 nodes Ready.

The check definition expects 25 nodes and warns when the ready count falls below 24, which is why three unready nodes has tripped a warning rather than nothing. Its critical threshold, critBelowReady, is 20.

So the current ready count of 22 is three above the first critical value: critBelowReady is 20, so critical means 19 or fewer ready, and 3 more nodes would have to go unready before this check turns critical. It is not critical yet, and at a 300-second check interval there is some room before it would be.
